newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanbo Steel shrs end limit down.
newsitem.headline: Hanbo Steel shrs end limit down.

text.p: Shares of South Korea's Hanbo Steel Corp fell 420 won to end Wednesday's trading limit down at 4,880 on rumours that it was facing bankruptcy, brokers said.
Hanbo officials denied the rumours, calling them "completely false".
Brokers said Hanbo Steel was rumoured to be in serious financial difficulty.
"These baseless rumours keep circulating, but I can tell you that they are completely false," said an official at Hanbo's press relations department who declined to be named.
Hanbo Steel, a leading maker of steel bars and hot-rolled steel sheets, posted a net loss of 88.89 billion won in the first half of 1996 on turnover of 332.64 billion.
